A 3rd file 'Olare Mara Kempinski- Stay 3 Pay 2 offer.pdf' is image-only (pdftotext returned only 1 byte) - skipped, promotional flyer, not re-rendered given it's a stackable-offer detail already summarized in the main contract's 'Offers' section (3 Nights Offer: pay 3 nights, implying a 4th night discount context - exact 'stay 3 pay 2' mechanic not independently confirmed from this specific flyer).
